name: slack_search_messages
description: This tool allows you to search messages across the Slack workspace using the standard search modifiers such as from:, in:, before:, and after:. Use this tool when the user asks to find a past conversation and you do not know which channel it is in. Search covers only channels the searching user can access, and very recent messages may take up to a few minutes to appear in the index.

query.description: Search query with optional modifiers, e.g. deploy failure in:#incidents after:2026-01-01.

sort.description: Order results by relevance score or by recency.

pagination.title: Pagination options
pagination.description: Standard cursor-based pagination controls shared by every list endpoint in this server.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned in the previous page of results. Omit for the first page.

page_size.description: Number of items to return per page. The server clamps values above the maximum.
